prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: step 2 of a four-image digital-product series — Design and build.
Input image 1 is a character and art-direction reference only. Keep the same recognizable cheerful browser-window mascot and early sound-era rubber-hose world. The mascot has one rectangular browser body, one black header bar with exactly three evenly spaced cream circular controls, an alert happy expression, exactly two continuous black rubber-hose arms, exactly two white four-finger gloves, exactly two legs, and exactly two black shoes. Show the entire mascot from top edge through both shoes with every connection visible.

Style: premium clean 1930s animation-cel editorial illustration, warm ivory paper, rich black ink, restrained charcoal wash, confident consistent contours, sparse hatching, subtle paper tooth, bright studio light, crisp contrast around face and hands. No muddy aging, sadness, fatigue, or stock clip-art look.

Format: standalone 3:2 landscape homepage process image. One large readable digital interface prop and one dominant action. Character and prop occupy about 72 percent of image height, with calm negative space, simple floor line, no panel border, and an 8 percent safe margin. Nothing is cropped or hidden behind a foreground table.

Constraints: no words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, logos, watermark, pseudo-text, or illegible UI copy. Devices are non-anthropomorphic with no face or limbs. No other character. No wires, cords, cables, hoses, pipes, dangling lines, exposed electronics, gears, gauges, servers, robots, bridges, plants, tailoring, conveyor belts, toolbenches, floating objects, or unexplained machinery. No extra, missing, fused, malformed, detached, cropped, or hidden limbs, gloves, fingers, facial features, screens, or props. Nothing intersects another object.
Scene: The happy browser mascot stands full-body in the center of a bright product studio, holding one large landscape tablet securely in its left glove at chest height while using one short thick stylus in its right glove. The tablet displays a crisp text-free interface made from one wide header block, two balanced content cards, and one large rounded action button. The stylus visibly touches the edge of the second content card as the mascot places it into the layout. The character looks directly at the interface with an enthusiastic, capable smile. Both arms, both gloves, both legs, and both shoes remain fully visible and distinct. Exactly one tablet and one short stylus; no desk, keyboard, stand, or paper.
